title: Observe the running vuoro-cloud PoC generation (is v0.1.0-poc.81 live?) through the operator tunnel, read-only
why_operator: The PoC Kubernetes API is reachable only through the operator WireGuard tunnel (NetworkManager profile vuoro-cloud-operator), which is down. The estate status report deliberately does not bring tunnels up, and the 2026-11-07 verification session was scoped to read-only checks, so activating the operator tunnel and using the PoC admin kubeconfig stays with the operator. Every cluster command below is a kubectl get; nothing is mutated, signed or deployed.

preconditions.check: The tunnel is currently down (so step 1 is needed and step 6 restores the starting state)
The PoC kubeconfig exists with owner-only permissions (metadata only; contents not read)
The desired generation is poc.81: highest signed tag in the Flux semver range on the GitHub source Flux watches
preconditions.observed: refs/tags/v0.1.0-poc.81 67c570967fd8..., refs/tags/v0.1.0-poc.81^{} 0733b420763b...; no poc.82 ref listed

commands.command: nmcli connection up vuoro-cloud-operator && ip -br addr show vuoro-cloud-wg

KUBECONFIG=/home/bayleaf/.config/vuoro/kube/poc.yaml kubectl -n flux-system get gitrepository vuoro-cloud -o jsonpath='{.spec.suspend} {.status.artifact.revision} {range .status.conditions[*]}{.type}={.status}:{.reason} {end}{"\n"}' --request-timeout=15s
commands.expected: suspend empty or false; revision v0.1.0-poc.81@sha1:0733b420763bbd7759baf34653f665726b87c97c; Ready=True and SourceVerified=True

vuoro-control, vuoro-control-admin, vuoro-gateway and vuoro-tenant-controller ready at their declared replicas with image ghcr.io/bayleafwalker/vuoro-cloud@sha256:e2c6b8d22d198d137bb6e66364cda6a77afe57fb737b1fc30de4dcde7dcb0505 (poc.81). sha256:e8fe72b0... means poc.80 is still serving.

commands.command: python3 scripts/estate_status.py --env vuoro-cloud --fetch --json > /tmp/estate-vuoro-cloud-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%MZ).json && python3 scripts/estate_status.py --env vuoro-cloud --from "$(ls -t /tmp/estate-vuoro-cloud-*.json | head -1)" --markdown | head -60
commands.expected: running.deployments, running.kustomizations and held.* now known; gate.next_blocking_gate evaluates (no 'tunnel is down' reasons)
Connection successfully deactivated (runbook operator-access.md: tear the tunnel down after the session)

expected_result: The running generation is known by observation. Expected, not observed, from read-only evidence on 2026-11-07: poc.81 is serving. The basis: the signed tag and commit verify against the trusted promoter key; the Forgejo promote-deployment run 4522 succeeded at 2026-10-29T17:34Z and published the tag to GitHub; and the GitRepository selects the highest signed tag in '>=0.1.0-0 <0.2.0-0'. Diagnosis if not: step 3 showing poc.80 means the Flux source is suspended, failing verification or not reconciling. Step 3 showing poc.81 while step 4 shows poc.80 images means the platform or apps Kustomization stalled; promotion has historically included a manual flux reconcile of the source and the three Kustomizations. Either case is a vuoro-cloud repair item, not an action under this package.
send_back: Output of steps 2, 3 and 4 verbatim (no secrets are printed by them)
The path of the estate JSON written in step 5, or its gate.next_blocking_gate and running.deployments values
Confirmation that step 6 brought the tunnel down

rollback.description: Nothing in the cluster changes. The only state change is the workstation tunnel; bring it down. If step 1 fails with 'unknown connection', the NM profile was lost (see operator-access.md 'Bringing up the tunnel'); stop and report it rather than recreating it.

references: vuoro-cloud:docs/runbooks/operator-access.md (Bringing up the tunnel on this workstation; explicit KUBECONFIG)
vuoro-cloud:IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md (Verified state, 29 October 2026: poc.80 checked at 15:59 UTC, before the poc.81 promotion)
